comment: T-Drum is T-Synth with the voices split out: the same nineteen parameters, of which only the synth selector has a widget on the panel. Unlike T-Synth it does not check that the chosen synth number exists (TrackerDrum.cpp:68 indexes the synth array directly), so a number past the end of the track's synth list reads past it. The CV outputs are written only while they are connected, so an unpatched one holds a stale voltage.
